rebirth-1991-keep-the-fame-ill-take-the-:

Luckily, I managed to survive, not as the female lead who witnesses all the horrors, nor as the handsome male lead who you’d expect to survive but tragically dies. I’m not the sleazeball who gets offed in a particularly gruesome way after hitting on every woman in sight, nor the best friend of the female lead who shares a fleeting romantic moment with a lover in an obviously creepy forest. Nope, I’m the prophet.

[Choking… Coughing… Wheezing…]
An alien creature, known only as Monster X, has taken an unsettling interest in me.
[Heavy breathing…]
And as if that’s not enough, a gas mask-wearing, knife-wielding maniac decides to skip heading to the cabin where the protagonists are and make a pit stop at the convenience store where I’m working.

But gratitude soon turned to fear.

No omega stepped forward and the promise remained unfulfilled.
Until Zahryssar demanded payment.
“If I could save your kingdom,” the Emperor declared, “I can erase it just as easily.”
With war threatening once more and innocent lives at stake, the Duke made a final choice to send his own omega daughter—only to be refused by her; she chose death over being sent to a monster.
And then, his son stepped forward.

A simple word.
A basic human need.

A city where closing your eyes means entering a horrific NIGHTMARE.
Inside these Nightmares, people are forced to face terrifying trials where survival is the only way out.
Fail...
And you die.
But death doesn't end there.
Those who perish inside their Nightmares leave behind something far worse—a SHADOW, a corrupted existence capable of hunting the living.
Sixteen-year-old Asher Reid never expected anything unusual when his family moved to Vespers.
But strange people, sleepless residents, unexplained disappearances, and terrifying encounters quickly convince him that something is terribly wrong with the city.
Then the Nightmare Curse begins to close in.
Asher must uncover the truth behind Vespers before it consumes him and everyone he loves.
In a city where closing your eyes is a death sentence, how far will you go to stay awake?
Welcome to Vespers.
Where sleep is death.

Humiliated. Discarded. Killed by the golden protagonist like every forgettable villain.
